literature.lead_zh: 本期人腺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 随着不同乙醇配方的增加,检测到随着酒精浓度的增加,还原因子也随之增加。在两种含酒精的混合物中,只有 M1 根据 EN 17430 的要求显示出功效,而第二种配方 M2 则勉强达到了功效。 [10.1016/j.jhin.2026.10.013]
该综述重点介绍了腺病毒、慢病毒、单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV) 扩增子、杆状病毒和噬菌体衍生嵌合体等关键结构配置,以及它们与转座子系统的整合。它还确定了潜在的限制因素,例如效率降低、包装和复制机制之间的不兼容以及免疫负担。 [PMCID:PMC13720247]
监测患者中HAdV感染率为27.1%,DNA血症发病率为16.0%。对于 队列研究,已证实或可能的 HAdV 疾病的 发病率 为 10.9%,对于 监测 的 发病率 为 12.6%。已确诊或疑似疾病患者的归因病死率为 13.5%。HAdV 感染和疾病在儿科同种异体 HCT 接受者中很常见。HAdV 疾病与大量 HAdV 归因的 死亡率 率相关。 [10.1093/cid/ciag398]

在这里,我们发现 4H30 对 A549 和 Calu-3 细胞中的多种 HAdV 亚型表现出广谱 抗病毒药物 活性,细胞毒性可忽略不计,并且对 A549 细胞中的病毒耐药具有高度屏障。值得注意的是,4H30 对人类呼吸道类器官中的 HAdV-3 以及免疫抑制仓鼠模型中的 HAdV-2 和 HAdV-5 仍然有效,显着减少病毒复制和疾病相关病理。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2755920]
接种疫苗的小鼠在很大程度上免受针对跨越二十年的流感 进化 毒株的致命攻击。两种 疫苗接种 途径均提供针对抗原相关菌株的完全保护,以及针对更趋异的进化枝 2.3.4.4b 菌株的强力保护。尽管所有 疫苗 均诱导了强烈的 H5 抗体反应,但在检测到中和抗体之前就发生了保护作用。 [10.3390/vaccines14110942]

[10.1016/j.jhin.2026.10.013]

The incidence of proven or probable HAdV disease was 10.9% for the cohort and 12.6% for those under surveillance. papers.title: Incidence and Outcomes of Human Adenovirus Infection and Disease in a Multicenter Cohort of Pediatric Allogeneic Hematopoietic Cell Transplant Recipients.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Human adenovirus (HAdV) among pediatric allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (allo-HCT) recipients can result in asymptomatic infection with risk for disease progression. There are limited data defining HAdV infection, disease, and case-fatality rates in a HAdV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) surveillance testing era. The current study aimed to define these outcomes using a priori definitions applied by a central review committee. METHODS: Pediatric allo-HCT recipients were followed up for 180 days after HCT at 10 pediatric institutions. Blood and stool specimens were collected 0-7 days prior to allo-HCT for serum HAdV immunoglobulin G and stool HAdV PCR testing. Clinical data, including HAdV PCR testing results, informed central review committee-designated outcomes of HAdV infection, including DNAemia, disease, and deaths (case-fatality rate). Outcomes were reported by HAdV surveillance testing status and by pretransplant research specimen results. RESULTS: The cohort included 819 allo-HCT recipients; 649 (79.2%) were under HAdV surveillance. The HAdV infection and DNAemia incidence among surveilled patients was 27.1% and 16.0%, respectively. The incidence of proven or probable HAdV disease was 10.9% for the cohort and, 12.6% for those under surveillance. The HAdV infection incidence was highest (13 of 25 [52.0%]) in patients with pre-HCT HAdV immunoglobulin G and stool PCR positivity. The attributable case-fatality rate for those with proven or probable disease was 13.5%. CONCLUSIONS: HAdV infection and disease are common among pediatric allo-HCT recipients. HAdV disease is associated with a substantial HAdV-attributable mortality rate. Clinical trials assessing novel HAdV in pediatric allo-HCT recipients are needed. Pretransplant serology and stool PCR testing could identify high-risk patients for trial enrollment.
papers.journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

papers.title_zh: 发病率 和 人腺病毒 儿童同种异体造血细胞移植受者多中心 队列研究 感染和疾病的结果。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human adenovirus (HAdV) among pediatric allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (allo-HCT) recipients can result in asymptomatic infection with risk for disease progression. There are limited data defining HAdV infection, disease, and case-fatality rates in a HAdV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) surveillance testing era. The current study aimed to define these outcomes using a priori definitions applied by a central review committee. METHODS: Pediatric allo-HCT recipients were followed up for 180 days after HCT at 10 pediatric institutions. Blood and stool specimens were collected 0-7 days prior to allo-HCT for serum HAdV immunoglobulin G and stool HAdV PCR testing. Clinical data, including HAdV PCR testing results, informed central review committee-designated outcomes of HAdV infection, including DNAemia, disease, and deaths (case-fatality rate). Outcomes were reported by HAdV surveillance testing status and by pretransplant research specimen results. RESULTS: The cohort included 819 allo-HCT recipients; 649 (79.2%) were under HAdV surveillance. The HAdV infection and DNAemia incidence among surveilled patients was 27.1% and 16.0%, respectively. The incidence of proven or probable HAdV disease was 10.9% for the cohort and, 12.6% for those under surveillance. The HAdV infection incidence was highest (13 of 25 [52.0%]) in patients with pre-HCT HAdV immunoglobulin G and stool PCR positivity. The attributable case-fatality rate for those with proven or probable disease was 13.5%. CONCLUSIONS: HAdV infection and disease are common among pediatric allo-HCT recipients. HAdV disease is associated with a substantial HAdV-attributable mortality rate. Clinical trials assessing novel HAdV in pediatric allo-HCT recipients are needed. Pretransplant serology and stool PCR testing could identify high-risk patients for trial enrollment.

papers.title: A Virucidal And Endosomal Trapping Peptide Against Human Adenoviruses In Respiratory Organoids And Hamsters.
papers.abstract: Abstract Human adenoviruses (HAdVs) are common respiratory pathogens that cause severe, life-threatening infections in immunocompromised individuals and children. Despite their medical importance, no clinically approved antiviral drugs exist. Here, we showed that 4H30, a 4-branched human defensin peptide, exhibited broad-spectrum antiviral activity against multiple HAdV subtypes in A549 and Calu-3 cells with negligible cytotoxicity and a high barrier to viral resistance in A549 cells. Mechanistic studies demonstrated that 4H30 exhibited a unique dual mechanism of action: direct virucidal activity through capsid disruption and endosomal trapping by impairing protein VI-mediated membrane penetration. Notably, 4H30 remained effective against HAdV-3 in human respiratory organoids and against HAdV-2 and HAdV-5 in an immunosuppressed hamster model, significantly reducing viral replication and disease-associated pathology. These findings demonstrate that 4H30 can inhibit multiple HAdVs through a novel mechanism, offering a new therapeutic avenue against HAdV infections.

papers.title: Efficacy of alcohol-based hand rubs against human adenovirus on contaminated hands.
papers.abstract: Viruses significantly contribute to outbreaks in healthcare facilities, primarily through direct or indirect hand contact. Consequently, hand disinfection using hygienic hand rubs is a pivotal measure for preventing nosocomial virus infections in medical environments. In 2024, the EN 17430 standard was introduced as the first method to evaluate the virucidal efficacy of hand disinfectants under practical conditions. The new method offers an advantage over suspension tests (e.g., EN 14476) by enabling the assessment of hand rubs using human volunteers. This study aims to compare the results of these two methods by investigating the in vivo efficacy of various ethanol formulations and two commercially available alcohol mixtures against human adenovirus type 5 (AdV-5). The in vivo efficacy of pure Ethanol formulations in concentrations from 60% to 97% and two alcohol mixtures (M1: 45 % ethanol and 18 % 1-propanol; M2: 45% 2-propanol and 30% 1-propanol) were evaluated on the hands of 5 or 20 volunteers, utilizing a cross-over study design based on EN 17430. With the different ethanol formulations increasing reduction factors with higher alcohol concentrations were detected. Of the two alcohol-containing mixtures, only M1 demonstrated efficacy based on the requirements of EN 17430, the second formulation M2, however, narrowly failed effectiveness. In conclusion, results from suspension tests with AdV-5 were not directly transferable to those obtained with the alcohol formulations tested under practical conditions as per EN 17430.

papers.title: A Confirmatory, Dual Center Nonhuman Primate Study on the Efficacy of Novel Oropharyngeal Spray Immunization With an Adenoviral Vector Vaccine Against RSV-Important Lessons Learned.
papers.abstract: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.

papers.title_zh: 关于腺病毒 媒介 疫苗 对抗 RSV 的新型口咽喷雾免疫功效的验证性双中心非人灵长类动物研究 - 重要经验教训。
papers.source_body_en: Background In a randomized, blinded, dual center study across two European primate research facilities, we evaluated the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a DNA prime-oropharyngeal adenoviral boost vaccination strategy against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Methods Rhesus macaques received an RSV fusion protein (F) DNA vaccine via electroporation, followed by two mucosal administrations of a recombinant adenovirus vector encoding the same antigen. Mock-vaccinated animals and a comparator group mimicking natural immunity induced by primary RSV infection were included as controls. Systemic and mucosal immune responses were monitored longitudinally. Results We detected robust cellular and humoral immune responses, but with some variability between the two centers. Nevertheless, RSV-vaccinated animals demonstrated markedly reduced viral replication in the upper and lower respiratory tract after RSV challenge infection. Unexpected RSV-specific immunity in the control group at one single study site prevented confirmation of the predefined primary endpoint. Conclusion Our results support the potential of mucosal adenoviral boosting following DNA priming to induce protective immunity against RSV, while highlighting challenges associated with multi-center preclinical vaccine studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 在欧洲两个灵长类研究机构的一项随机、盲法、双中心研究中,我们评估了 DNA 初免口咽腺病毒加强 疫苗接种 策略针对呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 的免疫原性和保护功效。方法 恒河猴通过电穿孔接收 RSV 融合蛋白 (F) DNA 疫苗,然后两次粘膜施用编码相同抗原的重组腺病毒 媒介。模拟接种动物和模拟原发性 RSV 感染诱导的自然免疫的比较组作为对照。纵向监测全身和粘膜 免疫应答。结果我们检测到了强大的细胞和体液 免疫应答,但两个中心之间存在一些差异。然而,接种 RSV 疫苗的动物在 RSV 攻击感染后,上呼吸道和下呼吸道中的病毒复制明显减少。一个研究中心的对照组中出现了意外的 RSV 特异性免疫,导致无法确认预定义的主要终点。结论 我们的结果支持 DNA 引发后粘膜腺病毒增强诱导针对 RSV 的保护性免疫的潜力,同时强调了与多中心临床前 疫苗 研究相关的挑战。

papers.title: The evolving landscape of hybrid viral vector architectures: a persisting niche

source_records.title: The evolving landscape of hybrid viral vector architectures: a persisting niche

papers.priority_tier_reason: 高相关性，且具备高等级研究设计、全文证据或较强数据库/引用支持
papers.full_text: The development of hybrid viral vectors was historically driven by the need to overcome inherent limitations of individual viral platforms, including restricted payload capacity, narrow tropism, and limited control over genomic persistence. By integrating functional modules from diverse viral and non-viral systems, these chimeric constructs exploit complementary mechanisms to expand therapeutic potential. This review examines the architectural principles underlying hybrid vector design, framing their evolution as a logical extension of viral engineering strategies - such as pseudotyping and genetic chimerization - rather than as a retrospective response to the rise of non-viral delivery platforms. We highlight key structural configurations, including adenoviral, lentiviral, herpes simplex virus (HSV) amplicon, baculoviral, and bacteriophage-derived chimeras, as well as their integration with transposon systems (e.g., Sleeping Beauty) to enable enhanced persistence and increased cargo capacity. In parallel, we analyze the biological and technological trade-offs associated with increased structural complexity, including manufacturing constraints, cumulative immunogenicity, and regulatory challenges. Collectively, hybrid vector systems represent a modular and evolving design paradigm that complements advances in monoplatform vectors and remains a valuable approach for addressing complex therapeutic challenges, for example those requiring expanded capacity, multifunctionality, or combinatorial control of gene delivery outcomes. 4ConclusionDespite decades of development of viral and hybrid vector systems, their evolution remains constrained by fundamental biological and technological barriers arising from mismatches between optimal solutions for delivery, intracellular processing, and expression of genetic material. The concept of hybridization logically follows from the modular organization of viral functions, implying the possibility of redistributing them across different platforms. However, in practice, functional decomposition of viral systems rarely leads to linear improvements in performance, since the integration of heterologous modules is accompanied by epistatic interactions and disruption of coordination across vector life-cycle stages.Historically proposed complex multicomponent hybrid constructs have so far seen limited clinical translation, as indicated by the relatively small body of evidence for their clinical use, despite decades of development. Potential contributing factors include reduced efficiency associated with increasing complexity of multistep delivery systems, incompatibility between packaging and replication mechanisms of different viral platforms, and constraints related to cytotoxicity of individual components and the need for coordinated expression of multiple genetic modules. An additional limiting factor is the immunological burden arising from the combination of viral elements of different origins, which restricts both efficacy and the possibility of repeated administration.In parallel, optimized “monoplatform” systems have undergone substantial development, most prominently adeno-associated viral (AAV) and lentiviral vectors, as well as non-viral delivery platforms including lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and polymer-based carriers. Alternative gene delivery and expression systems, such as engineered AAV capsids with enhanced tropism and production properties, lentiviral vectors with modified integration specificity, and LNP platforms that have become central for mRNA and genome-editing delivery, have further expanded the available toolkit. In these systems, directed evolution of capsids, engineering of regulatory elements, and optimization of manufacturing processes have substantially expanded therapeutic potential without the need to adopt complex chimeric architectures. As a result, a significant fraction of tasks that previously motivated the development of hybrid constructs has been partially redirected toward improving existing platforms, leading to a shift of hybrid strategies toward specialized solutions aimed at overcoming specific functional limitations rather than achieving universal optimization of delivery.Nevertheless, monoplatform systems remain subject to intrinsic trade-offs regarding key parameters such as transduction efficiency, payload capacity, tissue specificity, immunogenicity, and duration of expression. While non-viral approaches have further strengthened this alternative trajectory due to their scalability and reduced immunogenicity, they still retain limitations related to extracellular and intracellular targeting, efficiency of endosomal escape, and the absence of native mechanisms for nuclear delivery or genomic integration. The persistence of these structural gaps between required functional stages of delivery underlies the continued relevance of hybrid systems, which are inherently designed to redistribute functions among initially poorly compatible yet functionally complementary biological modules, thereby enabling emergent properties that cannot be achieved within a single evolutionarily or technologically constrained platform (Table 2). In our view, the most promising hybrid strategies are currently those in which the combination of modules provides a reproducible improvement of specific delivery stages without critically compromising overall biological compatibility. Regardless of cargo type - plasmid DNA, viral genomes, mRNA, or ribonucleoprotein complexes - therapeutic success depends on the vector’s ability to overcome a sequential series of biological barriers: stability in systemic circulation, tissue tropism, cellular entry, endosomal escape, intracellular trafficking, and, when required, nuclear import and sustained gene expression. As evolutionarily shaped self-replicating gene transfer systems, viral vectors possess integrated structural and functional features that actively mediate these steps. Receptor-defined entry, endosomal escape or membrane fusion, microtubule-associated intracellular trafficking, and regulated nuclear delivery are encoded within viral architecture rather than externally engineered. The molecular fate of delivered genomes is therefore determined not only by cargo design but by platform-specific post-entry mechanisms. Active nuclear import through nuclear pores may involve interactions between viral capsids or pre-integration complexes and cellular nucleoporins, as exemplified by lentiviral vectors capable of transducing both dividing and post-mitotic cells (Freed and Martin, 1996; Wyatt and Sodroski, 1998; Reiser, 2000; Cronin et al., 2005; Sun et al., 2010; Kubo et al., 2012; Lindemann et al., 2013; Hastie et al., 2013; Duvergé and Negroni, 2020). Genome processing further differs across platforms, including episomal circularization and concatemerization in AAV-derived systems or chromosomal integration establishing stable proviral structures in retro- and lentiviral vectors (Lieber et al., 1999; Shayakhmetov et al., 2002; Hac et al., 2025).Since the late twentieth century, gene therapy has been shaped by several dominant viral platforms, including adenoviruses, γ-retroviruses, lentiviruses, and adeno-associated viruses (AAV). Each provided a distinct balance of efficiency and biological constraint. While non-viral approaches have further strengthened this alternative trajectory due to their scalability and reduced immunogenicity, they still retain limitations related to extracellular and intracellular targeting, efficiency of endosomal escape, and the absence of native mechanisms for nuclear delivery or genomic integration. The persistence of these structural gaps between required functional stages of delivery underlies the continued relevance of hybrid systems, which are inherently designed to redistribute functions among initially poorly compatible yet functionally complementary biological modules, thereby enabling emergent properties that cannot be achieved within a single evolutionarily or technologically constrained platform (Table 2). In our view, the most promising hybrid strategies are currently those in which the combination of modules provides a reproducible improvement of specific delivery stages without critically compromising overall biological compatibility. full_text_sections.other: 1IntroductionEfficient delivery of genetic material remains the principal limiting factor in gene and nucleic acid therapy. Regardless of cargo type - plasmid DNA, viral genomes, mRNA, or ribonucleoprotein complexes - therapeutic success depends on the vector’s ability to overcome a sequential series of biological barriers: stability in systemic circulation, tissue tropism, cellular entry, endosomal escape, intracellular trafficking, and, when required, nuclear import and sustained gene expression. As evolutionarily shaped self-replicating gene transfer systems, viral vectors possess integrated structural and functional features that actively mediate these steps. Receptor-defined entry, endosomal escape or membrane fusion, microtubule-associated intracellular trafficking, and regulated nuclear delivery are encoded within viral architecture rather than externally engineered. The molecular fate of delivered genomes is therefore determined not only by cargo design but by platform-specific post-entry mechanisms. Active nuclear import through nuclear pores may involve interactions between viral capsids or pre-integration complexes and cellular nucleoporins, as exemplified by lentiviral vectors capable of transducing both dividing and post-mitotic cells (Freed and Martin, 1996; Wyatt and Sodroski, 1998; Reiser, 2000; Cronin et al., 2005; Sun et al., 2010; Kubo et al., 2012; Lindemann et al., 2013; Hastie et al., 2013; Duvergé and Negroni, 2020). Genome processing further differs across platforms, including episomal circularization and concatemerization in AAV-derived systems or chromosomal integration establishing stable proviral structures in retro- and lentiviral vectors (Lieber et al., 1999; Shayakhmetov et al., 2002; Hac et al., 2025).Since the late twentieth century, gene therapy has been shaped by several dominant viral platforms, including adenoviruses, γ-retroviruses, lentiviruses, and adeno-associated viruses (AAV). Each provided a distinct balance of efficiency and biological constraint. Adenoviral vectors (AdVV) enabled robust transient expression and efficient transduction of non-dividing cells but were associated with pronounced immunogenicity. γ-Retroviruses and lentiviruses supported stable genomic integration and long-term expression, yet raised concerns regarding insertional mutagenesis; γ-retroviruses additionally required cell division for efficient integration. AAV vectors demonstrated a comparatively favorable safety profile and durable expression in post-mitotic tissues but were limited by a restricted packaging capacity (∼4.7 kb), manufacturing challenges, and limited feasibility of re-administration due to neutralizing antibodies (Reiser, 2000; Lieber et al., 1999; Shayakhmetov et al., 2002; Hac et al., 2025; Nowicki et al., 2020; Yoder et al., 2021; Bestor, 2000; Pannell et al., 2000).By the 1990s, it had become evident that no single viral system simultaneously optimized delivery efficiency, safety, tropism, and genomic payload capacity. Within this context - well before the emergence of contemporary lipid nanoparticle (LNP) platforms - hybrid viral vectors (VV) began to appear as a logical extension of viral engineering. Pseudotyping of retroviral vectors with vesicular stomatitis virus glycoprotein (VSV-G) expanded tropism and enhanced particle stability (Duvergé and Negroni, 2020; Emi et al., 1991; Friedmann and Yee, 1995; Yu and Schaffer, 2006). Adeno–retroviral and adeno–AAV hybrid systems were explored to combine the high transduction efficiency of adenovirus with the integration or persistence properties of other vectors. In some cases, non-viral systems could also serve as donors of integration capability: for example, incorporation of transposon genomic elements (terminal repeats) can also yield hybrid vectors able to integrate genetic cargo into the host genome in the presence of transposase activity in target cells. Chimeric constructs incorporating packaging, regulatory, or capsid elements from different viral systems further illustrated an early strategy of functional complementation. Hybridization thus emerged as an intrinsic evolutionary step within viral vector development rather than as a response to non-viral technologies (Duvergé and Negroni, 2020; Lieber et al., 1999; Müther et al., 2009a; Feng et al., 1997; Caplen et al., 1999; Duisit et al., 1999; Kubo and Mitani, 2003; Kuate et al., 2004; Murphy et al., 2002; Tan et al., 1999; Soifer et al., 2001; Cunningham et al., 2024).In parallel, non-viral delivery platforms evolved substantially, including polymeric carriers and lipid nanoparticles. LNP systems, in particular, have demonstrated high transfection efficiency in vitro and have achieved clinical validation in the context of mRNA therapeutics and vaccination. Their advantages include cell-free manufacturing, compositional modularity, and scalable production processes. However, their biological limitations are systemic rather than purely technological. In vivo delivery largely depends on endocytic uptake with incomplete and variable endosomal escape; systemic administration often results in pronounced organ accumulation (notably hepatic enrichment for many LNP formulations); active nuclear import mechanisms for DNA cargo are absent; and expression is predominantly transient. In addition, repeated administration may provoke complement activation or adaptive immune responses (Bohana-Kashtan et al., 2004; Hou et al., 2021; Jung et al., 2022). These constraints reflect the absence of evolved viral mechanisms for membrane fusion, intracellular trafficking, and genome processing, and are not fully mitigated by formulation optimization alone.Against this background, hybrid vectors acquire renewed conceptual relevance. Virus–virus hybrids - through pseudotyping, chimeric capsids, or recombination of functional domains - enable targeted modulation of tropism, intracellular kinetics, and immunological profile while preserving viral entry and trafficking mechanisms. Virus–non-viral hybrids aim to integrate viral fusogenic or capsid-derived elements into synthetic delivery systems, or to combine viral and non-viral packaging strategies, thereby attempting to merge manufacturing modularity with biologically optimized cellular entry (Cronin et al., 2005; Duvergé and Negroni, 2020; Yu and Schaffer, 2006; Müther et al., 2009a; Kubo and Mitani, 2003; Kuate et al., 2004; Murphy et al., 2002; Zheng et al., 2000; Zhu et al., 2019). A substantial proportion of clinically relevant vector systems incorporate heterologous viral components and can therefore be considered, under the broad definition of hybridization adopted here, as hybrid or related vector architectures. These include pseudotyped retroviral and lentiviral vectors incorporating heterologous envelope proteins, particularly VSV-G, as well as rAAV vectors incorporating genetic elements and capsid components derived from different AAV serotypes, which could be considered a borderline form of hybridization (see Table 1 for examples and references). Nevertheless, while such hybrid or related architectures have reached clinical relevance, their clinical development has largely remained within the boundaries of functional chimerization rather than increasingly complex multicomponent platforms.TABLE 1Examples of clinically relevant viral vectors incorporating heterologous components.Product/candidateVector typeApplicationStatus/clinical trialsKymriah (tisagenlecleucel) (Awasthi et al., 2023; Leahy et al., 2018)VSV-G-pseudotyped HIV-1-derived, SIN-LVCAR-T therapy for B-cell malignancies (B-cell precursor ALL, DLBCL, FL)ApprovedELIANA (NCT02435849); JULIET (NCT02445248); ELARA (NCT03568461); BELINDA (NCT03570892)Breyanzi (lisocabtagene maraleucel) (Abramson et al., 2020; Munshi et al., 2021; Morschhauser et al., 2024; Breyanzi, 2022)CAR-T therapy for B-cell malignancies (DLBCL, HGBCL, PMBCL, FL, MCL)EMA-approved; TRANSCEND NHL 001 (NCT02631044), TRANSCEND FL (NCT04245839)Abe…

papers.full_text_excerpt: This review examines the architectural principles underlying hybrid vector design, framing their evolution as a logical extension of viral engineering strategies - such as pseudotyping and genetic chimerization - rather than as a retrospective response to the rise of non-viral delivery platforms. As a result, a significant fraction of tasks that previously motivated the development of hybrid constructs has been partially redirected toward improving existing platforms, leading to a shift of hybrid strategies toward specialized solutions aimed at overcoming specific functional limitations rather than achieving universal optimization of delivery.Nevertheless, monoplatform systems remain subject to intrinsic trade-offs regarding key parameters such as transduction efficiency, payload capacity, tissue specificity, immunogenicity, and duration of expression. In vivo delivery largely depends on endocytic uptake with incomplete and variable endosomal escape; systemic administration often results in pronounced organ accumulation (notably hepatic enrichment for many LNP formulations); active nuclear import mechanisms for DNA cargo are absent; and expression is predominantly transient. The development of hybrid viral vectors was historically driven by the need to overcome inherent limitations of individual viral platforms, including restricted payload capacity, narrow tropism, and limited control over genomic persistence. papers.title_original: The evolving landscape of hybrid viral vector architectures: a persisting niche

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the challenges and constraints in the evolution of hybrid viral vector systems, particularly in relation to biological and technological barriers that hinder their development and application. The background highlights the need to overcome limitations of individual viral platforms, such as restricted payload capacity and limited control over genomic persistence.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review examining the architectural principles of hybrid vector design, focusing on the evolution of these systems as a logical extension of viral engineering strategies rather than a response to non-viral platforms. It analyzes various structural configurations and their associated trade-offs.
analysis.methods: The review outlines the integration of functional modules from diverse viral and non-viral systems to expand therapeutic potential. It also discusses the biological and technological trade-offs of increased structural complexity, including manufacturing constraints, immunogenicity, and regulatory challenges.
analysis.main_results: The review highlights key structural configurations such as adenoviral, lentiviral, herpes simplex virus (HSV) amplicon, baculoviral, and bacteriophage-derived chimeras, as well as their integration with transposon systems. It also identifies potential limiting factors such as reduced efficiency, incompatibility between packaging and replication mechanisms, and immunological burden.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that hybrid vector systems represent a modular and evolving design paradigm that complements advances in monoplatform vectors. They note that while these systems offer potential, their clinical translation has been limited due to the challenges associated with their complexity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the ongoing development of hybrid vector systems as a valuable approach for addressing complex therapeutic challenges, such as those requiring expanded capacity, multifunctionality, or combinatorial control of gene delivery outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations such as reduced efficiency with increasing complexity, incompatibility between viral platforms, and immunological constraints. The evidence is based on a review of existing literature and is considered to have moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the challenges and constraints in the evolution of hybrid viral vector systems, emphasizing biological and technological barriers that hinder their development. It highlights the modular design of these vectors and their potential to expand therapeutic applications. The study notes that while hybrid systems offer advantages, their clinical translation has been limited due to complexity-related issues. The findings suggest that hybrid vectors remain a valuable approach for addressing complex gene delivery needs, despite the difficulties in achieving linear performance improvements. The review also identifies key structural configurations and trade-offs, such as manufacturing constraints and immunogenicity, which affect their practical application. The evidence is based on a comprehensive analysis of existing literature and is considered to have moderate confidence due to the limitations in the integration of heterologous modules and the challenges in achieving coordinated expression.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨混合病毒媒介系统的进化面临的挑战和限制,特别是阻碍其开发和应用的生物和技术障碍。背景强调需要克服单个病毒平台的局限性,例如有限的有效负载能力和对基因组持久性的有限控制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对混合 媒介 设计的架构原理的回顾,重点关注这些系统的 进化 作为病毒工程策略的逻辑延伸,而不是对非病毒平台的响应。它分析了各种结构配置及其相关的权衡。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述概述了不同病毒和非病毒系统的功能模块的整合,以扩大治疗潜力。它还讨论了结构复杂性增加的生物和技术权衡,包括制造限制、免疫原性和监管挑战。
elements_zh.main_results: 该综述重点介绍了腺病毒、慢病毒、单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV) 扩增子、杆状病毒和噬菌体衍生嵌合体等关键结构配置,以及它们与转座子系统的整合。它还确定了潜在的限制因素,例如效率降低、包装和复制机制之间的不兼容以及免疫负担。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,混合 媒介 系统代表了一种模块化和不断发展的设计范式,补充了单一平台 媒介 的进步。他们指出,虽然这些系统具有潜力,但由于其复杂性带来的挑战,它们的临床转化受到限制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为正在进行的混合 媒介 系统的开发提供了信息,该系统是解决复杂治疗挑战的有价值的方法,例如需要扩大容量、多功能性或基因传递结果的组合控制的挑战。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认其局限性,例如随着复杂性的增加而降低效率、病毒平台之间的不兼容性以及免疫学限制。该证据基于对现有文献的回顾,被认为具有中等可信度。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨混合病毒媒介系统的进化面临的挑战和限制,特别是阻碍其开发和应用的生物和技术障碍。背景强调需要克服单个病毒平台的局限性,例如有限的有效负载能力和对基因组持久性的有限控制。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是对混合 媒介 设计的架构原理的回顾,重点关注这些系统的 进化 作为病毒工程策略的逻辑延伸,而不是对非病毒平台的响应。它分析了各种结构配置及其相关的权衡。
analysis_zh.methods: 该综述概述了不同病毒和非病毒系统的功能模块的整合,以扩大治疗潜力。它还讨论了结构复杂性增加的生物和技术权衡,包括制造限制、免疫原性和监管挑战。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该综述重点介绍了腺病毒、慢病毒、单纯疱疹病毒 (HSV) 扩增子、杆状病毒和噬菌体衍生嵌合体等关键结构配置,以及它们与转座子系统的整合。它还确定了潜在的限制因素,例如效率降低、包装和复制机制之间的不兼容以及免疫负担。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,混合 媒介 系统代表了一种模块化和不断发展的设计范式,补充了单一平台 媒介 的进步。他们指出,虽然这些系统具有潜力,但由于其复杂性带来的挑战,它们的临床转化受到限制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为正在进行的混合 媒介 系统的开发提供了信息,该系统是解决复杂治疗挑战的有价值的方法,例如需要扩大容量、多功能性或基因传递结果的组合控制的挑战。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认其局限性,例如随着复杂性的增加而降低效率、病毒平台之间的不兼容性以及免疫学限制。该证据基于对现有文献的回顾,被认为具有中等可信度。

papers.title: Rare Adenoviral Vectored Vaccines for Emerging Influenza Threats
papers.abstract: Background: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases pose a growing global threat, underscoring the need for vaccine platforms enabling rapid deployment and durable, broad protection. Although mRNA and viral vector vaccines transformed pandemic responses, limitations include waning immunity, restricted antigenic breadth, pre-existing vector immunity, and rare vector-associated adverse events. Here, we evaluate recombinant adenovirus serotypes 4, 28, and 48 expressing a centralized H5 influenza hemagglutinin consensus antigen as next-generation vectors for broad, single-dose protection against diverse H5 influenza clades. Methods: An H5 centralized consensus vaccine was designed using human sequences from the 2003–2006 bird flu outbreak and cloned into four low-prevalence recombinant adenoviruses. Mice received a single intramuscular or intranasal vaccination and were challenged two weeks later with high doses of diverse, lethal, reverse-genetics-derived H5N1 viruses. Immune correlates, survival, and protection from challenge-associated weight loss were assessed. Results: Vaccinated mice were largely protected from lethal challenge against strains spanning twenty years of influenza evolution. Both vaccination routes conferred complete protection against antigenically related strains, and strong protection against more divergent clade 2.3.4.4b strains. Protection occurred before neutralizing antibodies could be detected, although strong H5 antibody responses were induced by all vaccines. Intramuscular vaccination generated strong serum IgG and antigen-specific T cell responses, while intranasal vaccination promoted robust antigen-specific mucosal IgA production. Conclusions: Adenovirus vectors expressing a centralized H5 consensus hemagglutinin elicit rapid, broad protection against diverse H5 influenza viruses following a single intramuscular or intranasal immunization. These results support the continued development of low-seroprevalence adenoviral vectors as a next-generation influenza vaccine platform for rapidly emerging influenza viruses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估表达集中 H5 流感血凝素共有抗原的重组腺病毒血清型 4、28 和 48 作为下一代 媒介,以针对不同的 H5 流感分支提供广泛的单剂量保护。这解决了当前 疫苗 平台的局限性,例如免疫力减弱和抗原宽度受限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及小鼠接受单次肌内或鼻内注射 疫苗接种 以及表达集中 H5 流感血凝素共有抗原的重组腺病毒,然后在两周后用多种致命的 H5N1 病毒进行攻击。
elements_zh.methods: H5集中共识疫苗是利用2003-2006年禽流感暴发的人类序列设计的,并克隆到四种低患病率重组腺病毒中。评估了免疫相关性、存活率以及对挑战相关体重减轻的保护。
elements_zh.main_results: 接种疫苗的小鼠在很大程度上免受针对跨越二十年的流感 进化 毒株的致命攻击。两种 疫苗接种 途径均提供针对抗原相关菌株的完全保护,以及针对更趋异的进化枝 2.3.4.4b 菌株的强力保护。尽管所有 疫苗 均诱导了强烈的 H5 抗体反应,但在检测到中和抗体之前就发生了保护作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 表达集中 H5 共有血凝素的腺病毒 媒介 在单次肌内或鼻内免疫后可针对多种 H5 流感病毒产生快速、广泛的保护。这些结果支持低 血清流行率 腺病毒 媒介 的持续开发,作为快速出现的流感病毒的下一代流感 疫苗 平台。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为快速、广谱流感 疫苗 的开发提供信息,该流感 疫苗 可用于预防新出现的流感病毒株,从而有可能减少未来大流行的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究由于使用单一动物模型和缺乏人类数据而受到限制。由于缺乏人体试验并且需要在临床环境中进一步验证,证据强度中等。

Here, we evaluate recombinant adenovirus serotypes 4, 28, and 48 expressing a centralized H5 influenza hemagglutinin consensus antigen as next-generation vectors for broad, single-dose protection against diverse H5 influenza clades. Methods: An H5 centralized consensus vaccine was designed using human sequences from the 2003–2006 bird flu outbreak and cloned into four low-prevalence recombinant adenoviruses. Mice received a single intramuscular or intranasal vaccination and were challenged two weeks later with high doses of diverse, lethal, reverse-genetics-derived H5N1 viruses. Immune correlates, survival, and protection from challenge-associated weight loss were assessed. Results: Vaccinated mice were largely protected from lethal challenge against strains spanning twenty years of influenza evolution. Both vaccination routes conferred complete protection against antigenically related strains, and strong protection against more divergent clade 2.3.4.4b strains. Protection occurred before neutralizing antibodies could be detected, although strong H5 antibody responses were induced by all vaccines. Intramuscular vaccination generated strong serum IgG and antigen-specific T cell responses, while intranasal vaccination promoted robust antigen-specific mucosal IgA production. Conclusions: Adenovirus vectors expressing a centralized H5 consensus hemagglutinin elicit rapid, broad protection against diverse H5 influenza viruses following a single intramuscular or intranasal immunization. These results support the continued development of low-seroprevalence adenoviral vectors as a next-generation influenza vaccine platform for rapidly emerging influenza viruses.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:新出现和重新出现的传染病构成了日益严重的全球威胁,凸显了对 疫苗 平台的需求,该平台能够实现快速部署和持久、广泛的保护。尽管mRNA和病毒媒介 疫苗改变了大流行反应,但其局限性包括免疫力减弱、抗原宽度受限、预先存在的媒介免疫力以及罕见的媒介相关不良事件。在这里,我们评估了表达集中 H5 流感血凝素共有抗原的重组腺病毒血清型 4、28 和 48 作为下一代 媒介,用于针对不同 H5 流感分支的广泛、单剂量保护。方法:使用 2003-2006 年禽流感 暴发 的人类序列设计 H5 集中共有 疫苗,并将其克隆到四种低 患病率 重组腺病毒中。小鼠接受单次肌内或鼻内 疫苗接种 注射,两周后接受高剂量的多种、致命、反向遗传学衍生的 H5N1 病毒的攻击。评估了免疫相关性、存活率以及对挑战相关体重减轻的保护。结果:接种疫苗的小鼠在很大程度上免受针对跨越 20 年的流感 进化 毒株的致命攻击。两种 疫苗接种 途径均提供针对抗原相关菌株的完全保护,以及针对更趋异的进化枝 2.3.4.4b 菌株的强力保护。尽管所有 疫苗 均诱导了强烈的 H5 抗体反应,但在检测到中和抗体之前就发生了保护作用。肌内 疫苗接种 产生强烈的血清 IgG 和抗原特异性 T 细胞反应,而鼻内 疫苗接种 则促进强劲的抗原特异性粘膜 IgA 产生。结论:表达集中 H5 共有血凝素的腺病毒 媒介 在单次肌内或鼻内免疫后可针对多种 H5 流感病毒产生快速、广泛的保护。这些结果支持低 血清流行率 腺病毒 媒介 的持续开发,作为快速出现的流感病毒的下一代流感 疫苗 平台。

papers.title: Adenovirus early proteins E1A and E3-19K reveal separable regulatory states of the ER stress sensor IRE1a.
papers.abstract: The unfolded protein response (UPR) controls cellular homeostasis and viral infections. It is canonically initiated by dissociation of ER chaperone BiP/GRP78 from lumenal domains of transmembrane sensor proteins, including the central UPR sensor inositol-requiring enzyme 1 alpha (IRE1a). This results in IRE1a activation and splicing of X-box binding protein 1 (XBP1) mRNA, leading to transcriptional activation of XBP1 for cellular adaptation and sustained infection. Human adenovirus (AdV) preferentially activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway through the viral membrane protein E3-19K, yet the mechanisms underlying this selective activation remain unclear. Here, we show that AdV uses two distinct early proteins to dissociate BiP from IRE1a and activate IRE1a-mediated XBP1 splicing. The immediate early protein E1A forms a complex with the cytoplasmic domain of IRE1a, sufficient to dissociate BiP from IRE1a without inducing XBP1 splicing or UPR activation. In contrast, E3-19K is expressed downstream of E1A, associates with the lumenal domain of IRE1a, and induces XBP1 splicing without promoting BiP dissociation from IRE1a. Both proteins were detected in IRE1a-containing complexes, consistent with stepwise viral regulation. Together, our findings show that canonical IRE1a activation hallmarks can be mechanistically separated during viral infection, revealing distinct AdV-regulated IRE1a activation states with discrete upstream and downstream signaling outputs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to elucidate the mechanisms by which human adenovirus preferentially activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway during infection, addressing a knowledge gap in understanding the selective activation of this pathway by viral proteins.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved molecular and cellular analyses of human adenovirus early proteins E1A and E3-19K, focusing on their interactions with the ER stress sensor IRE1a and its role in viral infection.
analysis.methods: The researchers used biochemical and molecular techniques to detect and characterize the interactions between E1A, E3-19K, and IRE1a, including the formation of complexes and their effects on BiP dissociation and XBP1 splicing.
analysis.main_results: Both E1A and E3-19K were detected in IRE1a-containing complexes, demonstrating a stepwise regulation of IRE1a by these viral proteins during infection.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal that human adenovirus employs distinct early proteins to regulate IRE1a in separate steps, showing that canonical IRE1a activation hallmarks can be mechanistically separated during viral infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of human adenovirus-induced ER stress responses, which could inform future studies on viral pathogenesis and the development of targeted therapeutic strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and molecular analyses, and the evidence is based on biochemical interactions, which may not fully represent in vivo conditions. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how human adenovirus selectively activates the IRE1a-XBP1 pathway through its early proteins E1A and E3-19K. The research demonstrates that these proteins dissociate BiP from IRE1a in distinct steps, leading to separate signaling outcomes. The findings highlight the mechanistic separation of IRE1a activation during viral infection, offering new insights into adenovirus pathogenesis. While the study provides valuable molecular data, its reliance on in vitro methods limits the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate in strength, as it is based on biochemical interactions rather than comprehensive in vivo observations.

papers.abstract_zh: 未折叠蛋白反应(UPR)控制细胞稳态和病毒感染。它通常是由 ER 伴侣 BiP/GRP78 从跨膜传感器蛋白的腔域解离引发的,包括中央 UPR 传感器肌醇需求酶 1 α (IRE1a)。这导致 IRE1a 激活和 X-box 结合蛋白 1 (XBP1) mRNA 剪接,从而导致 XBP1 转录激活以实现细胞适应和持续感染。人腺病毒 (AdV) 通过病毒膜蛋白 E3-19K 优先激活 IRE1a-XBP1 通路,但这种选择性激活的机制仍不清楚。在这里,我们证明 AdV 使用两种不同的早期蛋白将 BiP 与 IRE1a 解离并激活 IRE1a 介导的 XBP1 剪接。立即早期蛋白 E1A 与 IRE1a 的细胞质结构域形成复合物,足以将 BiP 与 IRE1a 解离,而不诱导 XBP1 剪接或 UPR 激活。相反,E3-19K 在 E1A 下游表达,与 IRE1a 的腔结构域结合,诱导 XBP1 剪接,而不促进 BiP 从 IRE1a 解离。这两种蛋白均在含有 IRE1a 的复合物中检测到,与病毒的逐步调控一致。总之,我们的研究结果表明,在病毒感染期间可以机械地分离典型的 IRE1a 激活标志,揭示独特的 AdV 调节的 IRE1a 激活状态以及离散的上游和下游信号输出。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在阐明 人腺病毒 在感染过程中优先激活 IRE1a-XBP1 通路的机制,弥补理解病毒蛋白选择性激活该通路的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及 人腺病毒 早期蛋白 E1A 和 E3-19K 的分子和细胞分析,重点关注它们与 ER 应激传感器 IRE1a 的相互作用及其在病毒感染中的作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生化和分子技术来检测和表征 E1A、E3-19K 和 IRE1a 之间的相互作用,包括复合物的形成及其对 BiP 解离和 XBP1 剪接的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在含有 IRE1a 的复合物中检测到了 E1A 和 E3-19K,这表明这些病毒蛋白在感染过程中对 IRE1a 进行逐步调节。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,人腺病毒 采用不同的早期蛋白在单独的步骤中调节 IRE1a,这表明在病毒感染过程中可以机械地分离典型的 IRE1a 激活标志。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 人腺病毒 诱导的 ER 应激反应的分子机制提供了见解,这可以为未来病毒 发病机制 的研究和靶向治疗策略的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和分子分析,证据基于生化相互作用,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据强度中等。

papers.title: An unusual case of adenovirus meningoencephalitis in an immunocompetent adolescent girl
papers.abstract: Human adenoviruses can cause infections at any age, but most commonly involve the paediatric population. Adenoviruses may cause a wide spectrum of diseases depending on the infecting serotype. The various clinical entities include respiratory illnesses, conjunctivitis, gastroenteritis, myocarditis, cardiomyopathy, cystitis, and meningo-encephalitis. Here we present an uncommon case of the latter in an adolescent girl, diagnosed by cerebrospinal fluid RT-PCR. These include mild aseptic meningitis, subacute focal encephalitius, myelitis, Reye syndrome and potentially fatal acute necrotizing encephalopathy, but are all rare in an immunocompetent host.

papers.title: A neutralizing monoclonal antibody targeting species B adenoviruses largely mimics the DSG2 receptor engagement mechanism
papers.abstract: Species B human adenoviruses (B-HAdVs), including HAdV7, HAdV3, and the re-emerging HAdV55, cause severe respiratory disease and engage desmoglein-2 (DSG2) through their fiber knob. Here, we report the identification and structural characterization of two monoclonal antibodies, 5C5 and 6G7, raised against the HAdV7 fiber knob. Both antibodies neutralize HAdV7 and display cross-reactivity toward other B-HAdVs, with nanomolar affinities. Notably, 5C5 recognizes HAdV3 despite limited sequence conservation and exhibits greater neutralization potency than 6G7. Cryo-electron microscopy structures at 1.8 Å and 2.0 Å resolution for 6G7 and 5C5 respectively, reveal distinct binding modes: 6G7 engages the trimeric fiber knob at a 3:3 antibody: knob ratio, whereas 5C5 binds the apex at a 1:3 ratio. The 5C5 epitope overlaps with key DSG2-interacting residues, including a conserved pocket among B-HAdVs, providing a structural basis for its enhanced neutralization through receptor-binding blockade. These findings establish the fiber knob apex as a vulnerable site for antibody-mediated neutralization and identify 5C5 as a candidate targeting pathogenic species B adenoviruses. Vassal-Stermann et al. identified two monoclonal antibodies that neutralize HAdV7 and cross-react with pathogenic species B adenoviruses. Cryo-EM reveals that the potent antibody 5C5 blocks the conserved DSG2 receptor-binding site at the fiber knob apex, defining a vulnerable target for broad neutralization.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the neutralizing mechanisms of two monoclonal antibodies, 5C5 and 6G7, against species B human adenoviruses (B-HAdVs), including HAdV7, HAdV3, and HAdV55. The research focuses on understanding how these antibodies interact with the fiber knob of B-HAdVs, particularly the DSG2 receptor. Cryo-electron microscopy reveals distinct binding modes, with 5C5 showing greater neutralization potency and targeting a conserved receptor-binding site. These findings highlight the fiber knob apex as a potential target for antibody-based therapies against pathogenic B-HAdVs. The study contributes to the development of broad-spectrum neutralizing agents and provides structural insights into receptor engagement mechanisms. However, the results are limited to the specific antibodies and B-HAdVs studied, and further research is needed to validate their efficacy against other strains.

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Saturday, October 31, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Respiratory pathogen survey reveals mixed infections in Zhuhai children by October 26, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 2 mins read 0 Respiratory pathogen survey reveals mixed infections in Zhuhai children Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram A two-year surveillance study in Zhuhai, China, found respiratory pathogens in 64.56% of 2,788 patients, with nearly half of the positive samples containing more than one organism. The analysis, which examined people enrolled through influenza-like illness and severe acute respiratory infection surveillance, identified 20 of 22 pathogens tested. Children aged 0–14 years accounted for 96.11% of positive cases, making them the principal population affected in the study population. Researchers analyzed throat-swab specimens collected from national sentinel influenza-like illness cases and hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection cases between January 2024 and December 2025. Each specimen was tested for 22 respiratory pathogens using real-time polymerase chain reaction, or real-time PCR. The study used descriptive epidemiology to characterize pathogen positivity, detect mixed infections and assess differences by age, sex and month. Because the sampling frame consisted of sentinel influenza-like illness cases and hospitalized patients with severe acute respiratory infection, the results describe the enrolled clinical populations rather than the full population of Zhuhai. The most prevalent pathogens were Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae, human rhinovirus, influenza A virus, human adenovirus and Mycoplasma pneumoniae. Mixed infections were common: 48.28% of positive samples contained multiple pathogens, and the combination of S. pneumoniae and H. influenzae was the most frequent. These findings indicate substantial co-circulation during the study period, although the observational design does not establish whether any pathogen caused a particular illness or clinical outcome. Discover more Study Biology Infectious Diseases infections Check Symptoms Read Med Journals Pathogen detection also varied by sex. Positivity rates for human rhinovirus, S. pneumoniae and H. influenzae were significantly higher among males than females, whereas M. pneumoniae positivity was higher among females. The age distribution was strongly concentrated among younger patients. Children from birth through 14 years represented 96.11% of all positive cases, and the highest positivity rate was observed in the 4–14-year age group. This concentration reflects the populations included in the surveillance system and should not be interpreted as a population-wide estimate of disease incidence. Monthly surveillance showed distinct seasonal patterns. S. pneumoniae and H. influenzae remained persistently dominant and produced synchronized peaks. Influenza A virus activity was marked by several epidemic peaks during the two-year period, while human rhinovirus circulated sporadically. M. pneumoniae and human adenovirus both peaked from May through September 2024. Overall, the results show that several respiratory pathogens circulated concurrently in Zhuhai from 2024 to 2025, with mixed infections, age disparities and pathogen-specific seasonal patterns. The authors concluded that children younger than 15 years were the primary affected group in the sampled population, supporting focused surveillance of this age group. analysis.time: The study was conducted between January 2024 and December 2025, with the report published on October 26, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The study focused on Zhuhai, China, analyzing throat-swab specimens from patients with influenza-like illness and severe acute respiratory infection. Children aged 0–14 years accounted for 96.11% of positive cases.
analysis.event: A two-year surveillance study in Zhuhai, China, found that 64.56% of 2,788 patients had respiratory pathogens, with nearly half of the positive samples containing more than one organism. The study identified 20 of 22 pathogens tested, including human adenovirus.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Mixed infections were common, with 48.28% of positive samples containing multiple pathogens. The most prevalent pathogens included human adenovirus, influenza A virus, and human rhinovirus. analysis.brief_en: A two-year respiratory pathogen surveillance study in Zhuhai, China, revealed that 64.56% of 2,788 patients tested positive for pathogens, with nearly half of these cases involving mixed infections. The study, published on October 26, 2026, focused on children aged 0–14 years, who accounted for 96.11% of all positive cases. Researchers used real-time PCR to detect 20 of 22 tested pathogens, including human adenovirus, influenza A virus, and human rhinovirus. The findings indicated that mixed infections were common, with the most frequent combination involving Haemophilus influenzae. The study also noted sex-specific differences in pathogen positivity, with human rhinovirus and Haemophilus influenzae more prevalent in males, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae more common in females. However, the observational design does not establish causation for any specific illness or outcome. The results highlight the concurrent circulation of multiple respiratory pathogens in Zhuhai during 2024–2025, with notable age and seasonal patterns.

elements_zh.time: 该研究于2024年1月至2025年12月期间进行,报告于2026年10月26日发布。
elements_zh.location_and_population: 该研究以中国珠海为重点,分析了流感样疾病和严重急性呼吸道感染患者的咽拭子标本。0-14岁儿童占阳性病例的96.11%。
elements_zh.event: 中国珠海一项为期两年的 监测 研究发现,2788 名患者中有 64.56% 患有呼吸道病原体,其中近一半的阳性样本含有一种以上微生物。该研究确定了 22 种测试病原体中的 20 种,其中包括 人腺病毒。
elements_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 混合感染较为常见,48.28%的阳性样本含有多种病原体。最流行的病原体包括 人腺病毒、甲型流感病毒和人鼻病毒。研究指出,男性中 人腺病毒 阳性率较高,而女性中肺炎支原体阳性率较高。研究结果强调了研究期间珠海市多种呼吸道病原体的共同循环。
elements_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该研究使用实时 PCR 来测试样本,并使用描述性 流行病学 来分析数据。它强调,结果描述了入组的临床人群,而不是珠海市的全部人口。观察性设计并未确定任何特定疾病或临床结果的因果关系。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Saturday, October 31, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Health Same RSV antigen, two vaccine platforms, two different immune maps in mice by October 28, 2026 in Health Reading Time: 5 mins read 0 Same RSV antigen, two vaccine platforms, two different immune maps in mice Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram Two experimental respiratory syncytial virus vaccines built on exactly the same prefusion F antigen do not simply produce stronger or weaker immunity depending on the platform — they produce immunity in different places, according to a head-to-head mouse study published in EMBO Molecular Medicine. When researchers at Sichuan University compared a lipid nanoparticle-formulated self-amplifying RNA vaccine with an adenovirus type 5-vectored vaccine, both delivered by intramuscular injection, the adenoviral vector preferentially built systemic immunity, while the self-amplifying RNA preferentially built immunity within the lung itself. The study, led by Yao Zhang, Yu Qin and colleagues, was designed to answer a question that has become increasingly pressing as RNA-based and adenoviral RSV vaccines both advance: does the vaccine platform itself, independent of the antigen and the delivery route, shape where in the body antiviral immunity is organized? To find out, the team constructed two vaccines encoding the identical stabilized prefusion F protein, based on the DS-Cav1 design that carries four stabilizing amino acid substitutions. Female BALB/c mice received either 2 micrograms of LNP-RSV-preF saRNA or 2.5 × 109 viral particles of Ad5-RSV-preF intramuscularly on days 0 and 21, followed by immune profiling at multiple time points extending to 120 days after immunization. Quality control confirmed that both platforms were functional. The self-amplifying RNA was verified as intact by gel electrophoresis, and the lipid nanoparticles, built from SM-102, DOPE, cholesterol and a PEG-lipid, showed particle sizes around 150 nanometers with an encapsulation efficiency of approximately 90 percent. The adenoviral particles measured roughly 123 nanometers. Both vaccines drove detectable prefusion F protein expression in transfected HEK293T cells in vitro, confirming that each could deliver and express the antigen, although the authors note that the denaturing immunoblot conditions used could not assess whether the expressed antigen retained its prefusion conformation. The earliest and most striking divergence appeared in serum antibodies. Fourteen days after the prime immunization, Ad5-RSV-preF induced serum prefusion-specific IgG titers approximately nine-fold higher than those produced by the RNA vaccine, indicating markedly faster systemic humoral priming by the adenoviral vector. After the booster dose on day 21, the RNA vaccine’s titers rose rapidly to levels comparable to the adenoviral vaccine, but by day 28 after the boost the adenoviral platform again held higher serum IgG levels. Both vaccines produced an IgG2a to IgG1 ratio greater than one, a profile the authors describe as Th1-skewed, a pattern considered favorable in RSV vaccine development because Th2-skewed responses have historically been associated with the risk of vaccine-associated enhanced respiratory disease. Neutralizing antibody measurements reinforced the systemic advantage of the adenoviral platform. In live-virus neutralization tests using serum collected 28 days after the booster, the geometric mean titer of the Ad5 vaccine against RSV strain A2 was 4898, compared with 1840 for the RNA vaccine; against RSV strain B the corresponding values were 1558 and 565. Yet the picture reversed in the airways. In bronchoalveolar lavage fluid collected on day 49, the RNA vaccine elicited significantly higher levels of IgG binding antibodies, while IgA levels in the lavage fluid were similar between the two groups. Antibody-secreting cell analysis by ELISpot revealed where these antibody responses were being generated. Seven days after the boost, Ad5-RSV-preF had induced more IgG-positive antibody-secreting cells in the spleen, whereas LNP-RSV-preF saRNA had induced more in the lungs; counts in the bone marrow did not differ significantly between the groups. Germinal center responses followed the same compartmental logic: in the draining lymph nodes, the adenoviral vaccine produced higher proportions of T follicular helper cells, plasma cells and germinal center B cells, while the RNA vaccine drove higher proportions of plasma cells and germinal center B cells in the spleen. The authors interpret this as the adenoviral platform favoring a classical, lymph node-centered priming pattern, with the RNA platform distributing B-cell activation differently across systemic and pulmonary compartments. T-cell responses showed a parallel split. In IFN-γ ELISpot assays of splenocytes, the adenoviral vaccine generated nearly twice as many IFN-γ-secreting cells as the RNA vaccine, and intracellular cytokine staining showed that Ad5-RSV-preF drove greater increases in TNF-α-producing CD4 and CD8 T cells in the spleen and greater increases in IFN-γ- and TNF-α-producing T cells in the lungs, along with stronger IL-2-associated recall potential after antigen restimulation. In the lung, however, the RNA vaccine produced more pronounced increases in CD69-expressing CD4 and CD8 T cells and higher proportions of both CD4 and CD8 tissue-resident memory T cells. In the authors’ framing, the adenoviral vector builds a readily expandable systemic effector reservoir, while the self-amplifying RNA establishes an activated, tissue-resident defensive population at the pulmonary site where RSV first encounters the immune system. Single-cell RNA sequencing of lung cells collected three days after the booster added a transcriptional dimension to this divide. The RNA vaccine reshaped the lung immune landscape toward a T cell-dominant state marked by proliferating, cycling T cells, and induced 1265 upregulated genes in pulmonary T cells compared with the unimmunized group, versus 486 for the adenoviral vaccine. Direct comparison showed the RNA platform associated with higher expression of genes linked to T cell differentiation and memory formation, including Tcf7 and Ccr7, while the adenoviral platform was associated with increased expression of cytotoxic and inflammatory genes including Gzmb, Gzma and Ifng, along with chemokine-related genes, and a more heterogeneous composition with increased NK cell representation. Broader flow cytometric profiling three days after the boost showed that both vaccines increased T cell proportions in spleen and lung, but with distinct biases: the adenoviral vaccine more prominently increased CD8 T cells in the spleen, while the RNA vaccine’s changes were more consistent with pulmonary activation and memory-associated redistribution. Long-term follow-up at 120 days preserved this compartmentalized pattern. Both vaccines maintained substantial serum IgG, with the adenoviral vaccine sustaining higher levels, and serum IgA did not differ significantly between groups. Ad5-RSV-preF elicited higher frequencies of long-lived IgG-positive antibody-secreting cells in the spleen and also in the lung, and roughly twice as many IFN-γ-secreting splenocytes upon antigen restimulation, indicating stronger durable systemic T cell memory. The RNA vaccine, by contrast, induced a greater frequency of long-lived IgA-positive antibody-secreting cells in the spleen — although the two platforms generated comparable numbers of long-lived IgA-positive cells in the lungs, a result the authors highlight as showing that the RNA platform did not provide a measurable long-term pulmonary IgA memory advantage in this model. The authors are explicit about the limits of these findings. No viral challenge experiments were performed, so the protective efficacy of either vaccine in vivo remains untested; the study used only female BALB/c mice and only the intramuscular route, leaving intranasal and other delivery routes unexplored, and the authors suggest that combined saRNA-adenoviral regimens merit future evaluation. What the study does establish, within its preclinical scope, is a framework: with antigen and route held constant, the choice between an adenoviral vector and a lipid nanoparticle-delivered self-amplifying RNA biases immunity toward systemic durability on one side or pulmonary-localized immune readiness on the other, a distinction the authors argue should inform how next-generation RSV vaccines are compared and selected. analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study reported that the adenoviral vaccine produced higher serum IgG titers and more IgG-positive antibody-secreting cells in the spleen, while the RNA vaccine showed higher IgG binding antibodies in the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and more pronounced T-cell responses in the lung. analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study was published in EMBO Molecular Medicine and conducted by researchers at Sichuan University. The authors suggest that combined saRNA-adenoviral regimens may be worth further investigation.

news.content_zh: 2026 年 10 月 28 日发表在 EMBO Molecular Medicine 上的一项临床前研究使用相同的预融合 F 抗原但不同的平台比较了两种呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 疫苗:脂质纳米颗粒配制的自扩增 RNA 疫苗 和腺病毒 5 型载体 疫苗。四川大学进行的这项研究发现,腺病毒疫苗诱导全身免疫,而RNA 疫苗则在肺部产生免疫。两种 疫苗 均在 HEK293T 细胞中驱动可检测的融合前 F 蛋白表达,免疫分析揭示了抗体和 T 细胞反应的差异。腺病毒平台显示出更高的血清 IgG 滴度和脾脏中更多的 IgG 阳性抗体分泌细胞,而 RNA 疫苗 在支气管肺泡灌洗液中引发更高的 IgG 结合抗体,并且在肺部产生更明显的 T 细胞反应。该研究没有测试体内保护功效,并且仅使用肌肉注射的雌性 BALB/c 小鼠,未探索其他途径。作者认为 saRNA-腺病毒联合治疗方案可能值得进一步研究。
